name: Touhou Kuru Ningyou 2 Alice to Issho -Alice to Eternal-
original_name: 東方繰人形2 アリスといっしょ -Alice to Eternal-
source:
You play as an university student. One day you stumbled upon a sleeping girl in the woods. The two of you get acquainted and made a promise to meet again.

[summary from [url=http://touhou.wikia.com/wiki/Alice_to_Eternal]Touhou Wiki[/url]]
